scope: Proposition 7.9 (Symbol interface) of the manuscript “A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion” (preprints/A-pointwise-2-converse-for-elliptic-curves-with-rational-two-torsion-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 004 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df42f33f68fbef77), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 64. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the arithmetic lower bounds in Lemma 7.5, the symbols of either coefficient source have the following properties. 1. For matching U, the trace on split elements factors through the maximal elementary 2-extension of F unramified outside S ∪ U. For opposite U, traces factor through the corresponding rational elementary extension. Adding a split vertex q is read by coefficient 1 of t(Frq)HU ; adding a simple vertex is read on the opposite BU . 2. Let p ∈ U and g = Frq. Changing one oriented ramification bit at p changes the symbol by A (︁ (U \ {p}) ∪ {q′ } )︁ , Frq′ ∼ gϕp, (7.16) unless p, q are both simple, in which case the change is zero. The replacement has the product labels at all retained places. Its coefficient system has support S ∪ (U \ {p}): the entire rational prime p, including both places above it when it splits in F, is omitted. 3. A split vertex with trivial label in the elementary extension for the other vertices has zero symbol. 4. In matching parity, insertion of two simple primes with equal rational labels on the fixed support and at the existing split vertices preserves the symbol if #E(Fq)/2 is odd for that label. Their mutual simple bits and their incidences with other simple vertices do not affect this statement. These are coefficient identities. Simultaneous realization of their labels by primes is a separate arithmetic construction.
